scope: main preservation contracts; separate variant/gate tests reported by test runner
tests: additive migration and repeat application preserve IDs and bodies
read-only audit reports an episode gap without renumbering
owner mismatch and cross-work episode attachment are rejected
draft cannot commit without its current revision
service-only save increments revision and rejects a stale writer
revision updates and deletes are forbidden even for table owner
snapshot must match source revision and remains stable after editing
one episode number and one idempotent result; cross-work result rejected
schedule pins immutable snapshot; duplicate active job and cross-episode snapshot denied
trash and moderation are independent from creator visibility
private schema cannot be read or written by anon/authenticated
restrictive storage rule overrides legacy permissive policies, other bucket preserved
account mapping conflicts fail without overwriting original identities
verified linking is atomic, idempotent and rejects impersonation/remapping
file references cannot cross works and referenced files cannot disappear
partial transaction failure rolls back and migration can be retried
locked P0 marker never becomes expanded during replay
local PostgreSQL backup restores legacy rows, versions and storage metadata
